rule: Lua tables of external modules. A local bound to `require` of a module the scan does not define, or to a member of one, gives no name to a function stored on it. It folds into the enclosing function. Calls of the library stay the library's ID at medium, including the mock's call of the saved original.
source: SPEC Decisions (2026-11-10, amendment): kong spec mocks of resty.dns.resolver and pl.utils
notes: Neither file is required, so each module is named by its path. The mocks resolver.new = function and utils.readlines = function fold into setup. old_new is a local alias of resolver.new and resolves to its target, medium (the library is not scanned). The production call utils.readlines stays the library's, medium, not the mock's.
